obligations.setup: Release in idle, and configure the master and an external slave that obeys the termination release rules.
obligations.stimulus: START, transmit 0/1, slave ACK, read one/two bytes with master ACK/NACK, and reset; check bus levels and sda_en while the external slave releases the line.
obligations.expected: SCL is released for high and pulled to 0 for low; when sda_en=0, the DUT only pulls SDA low or releases it during transmit and normal receive data phases. During the first source clk cycle of the ACK gap at the end of a received byte, the response selection is still Z, and digital combinational resolution makes SDA X (even when the slave releases it); this cycle must not be treated as a definite 1. When sda_en=1, ACK=0 or NACK=1 is driven directly (NACK is actively driven high, so operation is not strictly open-drain throughout). During the 16 cycles before START, SCL is high for the first 8 cycles and low for the last 8 cycles, and SDA is pulled low after the count>4; during data/ACK periods, SCL is high at tick4 through 11 and low otherwise. Read ACK/NACK is driven by the sda_en window; it is still disabled on the first clk of the first receive ACK gap and is enabled only on the next clk. ACK drive is retained for the first clk at the start of the second byte, then released.
obligations.sampling: Sample after settling after each clk and at phase midpoints; four-state bus resolution must not convert X/Z to bit in advance; compare only within the publicly specified legal, contention-free drive domain.
